subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this conflicted PR remain a landing candidate after rebase and full-runner proof, or should maintainers prefer another open fix candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but the branch is conflicting, changes retry/session/harness semantics, and overlaps with other open PRs for the same bug, so canonical direction is a maintainer choice.

options.title: Rebase and prove this PR
options.body: Keep this PR as a candidate only if it is rebased onto current main and adds full-runner or gateway proof showing retry recovery without duplicate side effects.

options.title: Use the stronger open candidate
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 if maintainers judge its proof and implementation to be the safer canonical path, then close or supersede this branch afterward.

options.title: Request a different retry contract
options.body: Pause both candidates if maintainers do not want the optional attempt-result field or the retry-before-failover ordering.

recommendation.title: Use the stronger open candidate
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 if maintainers judge its proof and implementation to be the safer canonical path, then close or supersede this branch afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent session-runner refactor history put this code path closest to Josh Lehman for routing the merge-risk decision.
